# RHIVE Construction (Quantum Roofing OS)
> Utah's Premier Transparent Roofing Contractor & Technology Platform
> Co-Founded by Kara Robinson (President) and Michael Robinson (CEO)

## Overview & Core Philosophy
RHIVE Construction is a female-led, tech-forward licensed roofing contractor headquartered in Sandy, Utah. RHIVE eliminates traditional door-to-door salesmen and middleman sales commissions to operate with administrative overhead strictly under 10%. Every estimate is itemized with mathematical transparency: Materials, Labor, Operating Overhead, and Net Company Profit.

## Core Roofing Systems (4 Strictly Decoupled Pillars)

### 1. Residential Roofing
- Pitch: Steep-slope residential homes, architectural re-roofs, residential flat additions, and modern decks.
- Standard: 100% full tear-off to bare wood substrate (no shortcuts), inspect decking, replace rotted wood (first 100 sq ft OSB decking included, $72.50/sheet upfront guarantee), high-temp ice barrier, synthetic underlayment, enhanced perimeter steel drip metal.
- Financial Guarantee: 50% down upon material delivery, 40% upon substantial completion, 10% final holdback until 100% client sign-off. Lifetime Craftsmanship Guarantee.

### 2. Commercial Roofing
- Scope: Architectural steep-slope systems (churches, banks, multi-family HOAs) and low-slope single-ply membrane roofing (retail, industrial, office warehouses).
- Specifications: GAF EverGuard® TPO/PVC systems (60 & 80 mil), ISO continuous insulation, tapered drainage sumps, DensDeck® prime coverboards, code layovers & full tear-offs.
- Warranty: GAF Diamond Pledge NDL (No Dollar Limit) manufacturer warranties up to 30 years with zero payout cap. Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and Commercial Roof Preventative Maintenance (RPSP).

### 3. Asphalt Shingle Systems
- Primary System: Owens Corning Duration® with patented SureNail® Technology (130 MPH wind warranty, triple-layer fastening zone).
- Impact Resistant: Duration FLEX® Class 4 Impact Resistant SBS-modified asphalt shingles for maximum hail and thermal shock protection.
- Designer Series: GAF Grand Canyon®, Camelot® II, and Owens Corning Berkshire® slate-profile luxury shingles.

### 4. Flat & Low-Slope Membrane Systems
- TPO Membranes: Heat-welded thermoplastic polyolefin (60 mil / 80 mil) with Energy Star® solar reflectance (CRRC rated).
- PVC Membranes: Chemical-resistant, fire-retardant polyvinyl chloride membranes for restaurant grease and chemical exhaust environments.
- Substrate & Thermal: Polyisocyanurate (Polyiso) high-R rigid insulation, 1/4" and 1/2" per-foot tapered drainage slope systems, and DensDeck® glass-mat roof boards.

## Transparent Pricing Formula & Accents
- Cost Breakdown: Material Wholesale + Direct Labor + Under 10% Operating Overhead + Company Net Margin.
- Zero-Surprises Guarantee: Rotted plywood decking replacement capped at $72.50 per 4x8 sheet ($2.27/sq ft) with pre-negotiated fixed change orders.
- Payment Protection: Strict 3-day statutory rescission right and zero final payment until physical cleanup, magnetic nail sweep, and owner sign-off.

## 23 Utah Service Locations
RHIVE provides full permitting, localized ice damming protection, and high-wind installations across:
- Salt Lake County: Salt Lake City, Sandy, West Jordan, South Jordan, Draper, Herriman, Murray, Midvale, Millcreek, Holladay, Cottonwood Heights, Sugar House, Taylorsville, Kearns, Magna, West Valley City.
- Davis County: Bountiful, North Salt Lake, Layton, Clearfield.
- Weber County: Ogden.
- Summit County: Park City.
- Tooele County: Tooele.
